official_keep.hands: all available official left/right hands and visible forearms

SAM_combination.actor_instance_policy: union all returned actor instances using existing backend default output_prob_thresh0.35; preserve every raw model instance
SAM_combination.task_object_condition: only if the allowed official task-object label has no instance on this exact frame
SAM_combination.rough_polygon_use: tight bounding-box guidance on task-object query ONLY; no pixel gold, no actor clipping, no output IoU selection
SAM_combination.union: filtered official hands/task-object plus retained SAM actor masks plus conditional task-object masks
SAM_combination.failure: keep filtered official proposals; explicitly flag missing/unknown actor or task-object coverage; never imply zero truth
SAM_combination.actor_query_guidance: person and hand TEXT ONLY, no human box constraint
SAM_combination.task_object_query_guidance: text plus tight rough-human box when available; text only otherwise; no additional query calls
SAM_combination.mask_binarization: preserve binary model output; wrapper _unpack_outputs uses >0 on out_binary_masks, nearest resize if needed; not a new0.5 score threshold

coarse_bbox_guidance.use: coarse input guidance only; not reference pixels or automatic acceptance

review_v2.old5_blinds: retained unchanged as old review history; absence of old overlay is not a model miss
review_v2.approval_meaning: approve FINAL displayed mask and complete correction only; rough polygons remain non-reference until explicitly approved
